scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix shell && npm install --prefix microfrontends/mf-auth && npm install --prefix microfrontends/mf-onboarding && npm install --prefix microfrontends/mf-kyc && npm install --prefix microfrontends/mf-documents && npm install --prefix microfrontends/mf-credit
scripts.build:mfs: npm run build --prefix microfrontends/mf-auth && npm run build --prefix microfrontends/mf-onboarding && npm run build --prefix microfrontends/mf-kyc && npm run build --prefix microfrontends/mf-documents && npm run build --prefix microfrontends/mf-credit
scripts.start: concurrently -n "AUTH,ONB,KYC,DOCS,CREDIT,SHELL" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red" "npm run preview --prefix microfrontends/mf-auth" "npm run preview --prefix microfrontends/mf-onboarding" "npm run preview --prefix microfrontends/mf-kyc" "npm run preview --prefix microfrontends/mf-documents" "npm run preview --prefix microfrontends/mf-credit" "npm run dev --prefix shell"
scripts.dev: npm run build:mfs && npm run start
